- Update staging safely replaces files left by older installers or FTP tools.
- Longer Discover pages load progressively, with a visible scrollbar.
- Click L3 to switch movies/series and R3 to cycle catalog sorts.
- Condensed page control at the bottom right; remove misleading filter arrows.
- Preserve selection as additional catalog results arrive.
- Request details show the saved quality and requester, with Close at the bottom right.
- Clear Data resets stuck Seerr tracking after confirmation, for permitted accounts. Library files stay.
- Returning from a show preserves library cards and scroll position without a fade or refetch.
